name: GitHub Open PR
description: Create a pull request in a bounded GitHub repository with explicit base/head branches and a reviewed body file.

head.description: Source branch for the pull request

body_file.description: Relative path to the PR body file

steps.description: Create the pull request through GitHub CLI

constraints: Repository, base branch, head branch, and PR body file are explicit approved inputs
PR body content is content-hash-bound through the reviewed body_file input
The command surface is fixed to gh pr create with no extra flags
invariants: No merge, push, or branch mutation happens through this recipe
GitHub CLI auth must be present in the runtime before execution
Only structured gh argv is allowed

requires_auth.message: GitHub CLI login is required to open a pull request.
